summary: Simulations Plus filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement with an affiliate of Altaris, LLC (Parent). Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge into the Company, with Simulations Plus surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. Shareholders will receive $18.50 per share in cash for each share held, excluding treasury and Parent-owned shares. The Board unanimously approved the deal, deemed it fair, and recommends adoption by shareholders. The transaction is structured as a cash merger, subject to shareholder vote and regulatory approvals. Watch for the shareholder meeting timeline and any competing bids.
